name: herma
summary: Herma: context-shimming AI middleware for configurable coding harnesses -- intercepts requests via keyword, semantic, or micromodel rules to respond directly or shim atomic Task Object, Task, and URI context from a caller-isolated database before LLM execution. Rules, deterministic entity memory, and atomic Task Object and Task entries load from SQLite/D1, governed Tessera stores and blobs, or remote handshake servers; personal assistants use the same scoped credentials as coding harnesses; contributor-tier models are refused.

status.notes: Natural-language Tasks (verbs) & Task Objects (nouns) direct lookup, PROV-HARNESS-FEEDS-GUIDE and PROV-LORA-MEMORY-ROUTING starters with full fabric_governance lens parity, Meta AI model-role matrix, reproducible training/ and eval/ artifacts, standalone Dockerfile, caller-isolated SQLite/D1 CAS, deterministic entity memory, and stateless JSON-RPC /mcp verified across Python and Cloudflare Worker + D1.

components.title: RFC 9457 error hierarchy
components.role: Maps typed middleware, scope, builtin-protection, admin-lockdown, governance, harness, and contributor-tier refusals to deterministic HTTP statuses

components.title: Provision, context-entry, memory, insights, trigger, key, and receipt schemas
components.role: Strict Pydantic models for caller-scoped provisions, versioned context entries, working entities, rule outcomes, candidate insights, 3-tier triggers, harness keys, and SHA-256 receipts

components.title: Configurable-harness access gate
components.role: Verifies constant-time hmk_ secrets, enforces route/configure/admin scopes, allows credentialed personal assistants, and blocks every model ID containing contributor

components.title: Deterministic anti-RAG entity extractor and candidate synthesizer
components.role: Extracts file_path, code_symbol, tessera_uri, statute_card_id, and error_signature entities via zero-LLM regexes and synthesizes reviewable candidate_provisions

components.title: Three-tier trigger engine
components.role: Evaluates Tier-1 keyword/regex/path/tool, Tier-2 semantic cosine, and Tier-3 micromodel classifier triggers with short-circuiting and pre-fallback contributor refusal

components.title: Caller-isolated provision, context, entity memory, and outcome store + governed sync
components.role: SQLite WAL store with composite caller_scope PKs, atomic SQL CAS, system_builtin protection, Layer-1 governed Tessera CAS/blob/noun-verb sync, entity memory, and rule outcomes

components.title: Multi-protocol context shimmer, entity tracker, direct-response builder & receipt minter
components.role: Extracts prompt/path/tool signals and deterministic entities across chat_completions, responses, and messages, attributes Turn N retry errors, shims caller-scoped context or builds direct responses, and mints SHA-256 receipts

components.title: Direct-response short-circuit & upstream forwarding engine
components.role: Evaluates caller-isolated active provisions, short-circuits respond_directly rules into protocol-faithful completions, or forwards shimmed payloads (JSON or SSE) to allowlisted upstream LLM endpoints

components.title: FastAPI HTTP service, context/memory/insights API, preview, discovery & stateless MCP
components.role: Serves caller-isolated proxy, context, memory, outcomes, insights, read-only /api/preview, SVG brand pages, discovery routes, and stateless JSON-RPC /mcp behind HERMA_EDGE_SECRET lockdown; renders the shared Meta model catalog (herma/model_catalog.json) that the Worker imports too

components.title: Typed work conversation
components.role: Caller-scoped typed proposals, per-caller operator grants, explicit provider-plan nouns with one upstream model identity per route, per-attempt spend reservations in exact microdollars and private attribution; native Muse/OpenAI/Anthropic adapters and pure Jev worker wire preparation; no generated action execution

components.title: Command-line interface and end-to-end demo
components.role: Provides seed, keys, context, dry-run, 3-tier Tessera-synced context-shim + direct-response demo, and serve commands

components.title: Cloud Worker & Edge
components.role: 24/7 native Cloudflare Worker + D1 (ta-amps-herma) + Tessera Cloud Service Binding with caller_scope isolation, atomic SQL CAS, deterministic entity memory, candidate insights, /api/preview, discovery routes, and stateless /mcp

invariants.statement: Personal assistants with scoped keys are accepted; browser navigation and cookie authentication are refused
Provision management and remote sync require both configure scope and explicit matching X-Herma-Harness attestation

Contributor-tier models (any model ID containing contributor, including -contributor) are refused across outbound LLM payloads, micromodel trigger classifiers, provider plans and operator grants before offline fallback
Tier-1 keyword, bounded regex, path-glob, and tool-name triggers match deterministically without network calls
Tier-2 semantic triggers match paraphrased intent without literal keyword overlap
Tier-1 or Tier-2 hits short-circuit Tier-3 micromodel calls when trigger mode is any
Single-statement atomic SQL compare-and-set versions prevent silent provision and context_entries overwrites, Tessera blob URIs verify SHA-256 digests, and remote handshakes clamp max_chars
Multi-turn conversations deduplicate once_per_conversation provisions and HERMA_EDGE_SECRET blocks direct origin traffic lacking x-edge-auth
Matched context_refs shim bounded atomic noun, verb, and detail entries from caller-scoped context_entries or governed Tessera stores and record shimmed_context_refs in the receipt
Provisions with action=respond_directly return protocol-faithful completions across chat_completions, responses, and messages without invoking upstream LLM transport while recording a SHA-256 receipt

Caller-scoped provisions, context_entries, and receipts never poison or leak across keys, system_builtin records return 403 builtin_protected on non-admin writes, and /v1/admin/keys requires bootstrap/admin credentials

Layer-1 Tessera governance refuses status:quarantined records, requires status:verified across surfaces, enforces visibility_scope/cohort/harness tags, and verifies 64-hex SHA-256 digests on tessera://blobs URIs

Deterministic regex extraction tracks 5 entity kinds per (caller_scope, project_tag), attributes Turn N error signatures to Turn N-1 fired rules as retry_error, and emits Provision-valid candidate_provisions without mutating active rules

Public POST /api/preview evaluates system_builtin rules with persisted=false, SVG brand chrome renders cleanly, and discovery routes plus stateless JSON-RPC POST /mcp match across Python and Cloudflare Worker

Micromodel decisions require boolean apply and finite numeric confidence in [0,1], malformed replies do not activate fallback, and offline trigger evaluation skips classifier and remote embedding requests

Operator-funded conversation turns require the caller's own exact provider/model grant; uncertain-outcome failover requires that caller's grant plus the plan opt-in; one upstream model identity is reachable through one route per plan and is held against other routes during its rate or quota limit
Served pages, discovery text, starter seed data and runtime sources never name a retired pack, and fabric imports trust only the current producer surfaces: Tessera, Herma, Eranos and Agora

Starters synced from Tessera into system_builtin fire for routed callers only when they carry fabric_governance that passes the Layer-1 lens, and Python and the Worker decide every stored row the same way

Served pages, public JSON and shipped files pass the ONE shared banned-word list, which is read from outside this repository and never copied into it (MUST-FOLLOW rule 16), and the public model list comes from one catalog that the Python and Worker pages render identically with agent programs kept out of the model table
Herma routes only catalog models that carry a standard-mode price ceiling, its default upstream and allowlist lead with the Meta API in both runtimes, and no catalog entry is a contributor-tier id

Every public Herma page is light only (color-scheme only light in its meta tag and on :root, no dark-scheme media query, no opaque dark panel under either colour scheme), carries the one thin agent banner, the header and the standard footer (the shared ta-amps.footer/1 spec: the brand and one row of links, then one short line) from a single shell (herma/page_shell.json) that the Python and Worker renderers produce byte for byte alike, and shows worker-written text only after the display-time filter (tidyText), which is built on the server from the shared banned-word list and never sent to a browser, and never alters a stored record

A deploy of the Worker from any checkout of this repository is refused unless the tree is clean, the commits listed in deploy/cloudflare/release-policy.json (the one that is live and the Muse-first release) are contained in HEAD, the page asset versions are current, the word-list module comes from the shared banned-word list and not from an override, the banned-word gate passes that list on every served surface (and fails closed without it), and the light check passes

A /q/help request reserves its Meta call in one atomic statement before it makes it (the daily call cap, the public day cap and the total budget are checked together against the worst-case cost of the prompt), settles the same row afterward, and counts failed and uncertain attempts, so a burst of simultaneous requests cannot spend past a cap

Herma keeps no visitor address and no full browser string: persisted traces and automatic request logs are off, the trace log and the bridge records keep a coarse client family, and nothing is derived from an address

The network map keeps per claim only the Cloudflare data center and continent (never an IP address, city, coordinate, network or user agent; none at all for a worker that left the map) for 30 days and then only a count per day and continent; it names a claim's data center only when 2 or more workers of its kind made claims there in the 15 minutes up to it, one decision per claim for the feed, the replay and the place list; it shows only claims of public Tasks (any other claim counts in the totals only); it accepts Tessera's data centers and rows only as far as Tessera's own counts and per-row marks show them; a worker's show_on_map changes only with that worker's token or in the call that creates the worker; and it answers GET /q/network cached for 15 seconds to the five contract origins, with a generous cap per address

Herma has one canonical host, herma.teleionlabs.com: any other host that reaches the Worker is answered with a redirect that keeps the path and the query (301 for GET and HEAD, 308 for every other method, so an agent's POST to /q/* keeps its method and body), and every page that exists names rel=canonical

What an agent shows its person after it reports a Task is two plain lines written by the server (links to the Task Object, the worker and the dashboard, then the next turn), with no hash and no receipt
The home, Get started and Trust & safety pages are rendered from one content Task Object (herma/page_content.json) by both runtimes, byte for byte alike

import_rules.why: Ring 0 holds pure schemas, error contracts, and stateless harness access gates with zero I/O
Core memory, trigger, store, and injection engines never depend on FastAPI or CLI entry points
Runtime package code never imports test, build, or deployment folders

claims.claim: Herma evaluates keyword, semantic, and micromodel triggers to shim versioned provisions and URIs across chat_completions, responses, and messages while preserving caller-scoped access for coding harnesses and personal assistants
Herma loads and syncs versioned provisions and atomic noun/verb context entries from governed Tessera CAS/blob/noun stores and remote handshake servers with SHA-256 digest checks
Herma shims caller-isolated atomic noun, verb, and detail context or responds directly across all 3 LLM wire protocols with zero upstream token spend and zero cross-caller poisoning

Herma tracks deterministic working entities without embeddings, attributes retry errors across turns, and synthesizes reviewable Provision-valid candidate rules on /v1/insights without mutating active provisions
Herma serves a zero-write interactive preview, SVG boundary-pillar chrome, discovery endpoints, and stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 /mcp in parity across FastAPI and Cloudflare Worker
